headline: The Washington Post: China exports its economic problems to the world
summary: A Washington Post analysis says China shows cracks in employment, real estate and local finances while its external engine accelerates. It questions how long the current economic model can be sustained.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major exporter, so domestic strains and export momentum affect global trade, commodity demand and Asian markets.
